name: zos-platform
description: ZOS Platform monorepo — Z Find, Z Mobility, Z Jobs, Z Studio, Z Fashion, Z Desk and shared platform capabilities.

scripts.zos:setup: npm run studio:setup && npm ci --prefix apps/studio/commercial && npm run fashion:setup && npm run desk:setup
scripts.zos:check: npm run jobs:typecheck && npm run jobs:test && npm run find:check && npm run mobility:typecheck && npm run mobility:test && npm run studio:check && npm run fashion:check && npm run desk:check
scripts.zos:test: npm run jobs:test && npm run find:test && npm run mobility:test && npm run studio:test && npm run studio:commercial:test && npm run fashion:check && npm run desk:test
scripts.zos:build: npm run find:build && npm run mobility:build && npm run studio:build && npm run desk:build
scripts.jobs:typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@zjobs/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace=@zjobs/api
scripts.find:build: npm run build:zfind --workspace=z-find-platform && npm run build:admin --workspace=z-find-platform && npm run build:partner --workspace=z-find-platform
scripts.studio:ai:check: npm run check --prefix apps/studio/backend && npm test --prefix apps/studio/backend
scripts.studio:check: npm run studio:build && npm run studio:test && npm run studio:ai:check && npm run studio:commercial:check && npm run studio:commercial:test
scripts.fashion:setup: npm ci --prefix apps/fashion/packages/fashion-domain && npm ci --prefix apps/fashion/apps/fashion-partner
scripts.fashion:check: npm run fashion:domain:test && npm run fashion:partner:test && npm run fashion:web:test
scripts.desk:setup: npm install --prefix apps/desk --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix apps/desk/backend --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.desk:typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/desk && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/desk/backend
scripts.desk:check: npm run desk:typecheck && npm run desk:test
scripts.desk:build: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:54321 NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=build-anon-key DESK_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 npm run build --prefix apps/desk && npm run build --prefix apps/desk/backend
